chunk: A1 (plants2 PROBE - not a Phase A product)
absolute_scale: UNRESOLVED. No fiducial, no known dimension, no EXIF. Every distance in every A1 product is in rdu (relative depth units), 1 rdu = the median scene depth of that raster. Do not convert to metres.

camera.note: regressed by Depth Anything 3's CameraDec.fc_fov; the depth in this product is conditioned on it, so it is self-consistent, not measured

primary_geometry.why: camera head physically consistent at this resolution

camera.note: regressed by Depth Anything 3's CameraDec.fc_fov; the depth in this product is conditioned on it, so it is self-consistent, not measured [rescaled from 378x504]

primary_raster.why: this run's OWN camera estimate has fx/fy = 0.558; the camera recorded here is the res-504 estimate rescaled to this grid, as A1 did.

depth_semantics.quantity: depth (z along the optical axis), not disparity, not ray length
depth_semantics.container: .npy — no normalisation, no clipping, no 8-bit anywhere

instrument_constants_for_later_chunks.depth_resolution_floor_method: robust second-difference (Immerkaer) estimator on the primary raster, MAD-based; the smallest pixel-to-pixel depth step the raster can express distinguishably
instrument_constants_for_later_chunks.for_A4_depth_continuity: a tolerance below the resolution floor (4.15e-05 rdu) is meaningless; the practical value should be read off local_planarity_p10 at the window size A4 actually links over
instrument_constants_for_later_chunks.for_A2_ransac_inlier_threshold: the surface's own roughness dominates: p10 at win33 is 5.67e-04 rdu and the whole-scene dominant-plane fit only stabilises around 1e-2 rdu — see results/quantisation.json soil_fit_sensitivity

downstream_rule: every artifact derived from these products must carry scale_confidence='scale_free' (or 'assumed_scale' if A1b intrinsics were substituted). depth_to_cloud.save_cloud enforces this.
